description: This file defines a ProseMirror plugin for handling mathematical notation within the Notesnook editor, including node views for inline and block math, plugin state management, and integration with KaTeX rendering.

classes.name: IMathPluginState
classes.description: Interface representing the state of the math plugin, including macros, active node views, and previous cursor position.

classes.name: MathView
classes.description: Class representing the visual node view for math elements in the editor.

methods.name: createMathView
methods.description: Factory function that creates a node view for inline or block math nodes, integrating with the plugin state.
